$comment: Tracked, unlike settings.local.json: these rules describe the repo, not this machine.
Submodules here are revision records, not workspaces. The copy that deploys lives in
the app's own clone under ~/Code — an edit inside a submodule worktree changes a file
that can never ship, and the superproject reports it as a dirty gitlink rather than as
the change it is. scripts/submodules-lock.sh enforces this on the filesystem; these
rules are the version that can explain itself, and they fire before the write is
attempted rather than after it fails with EACCES.
additionalDirectories names ~/Code so the correct checkout is reachable by default.
